us_location_reviews.source_note: The 2023 Form 10-K lists a Mountain View principal executive office and describes Confluent Cloud and Platform.
The FY2024 Form 10-K designates Bozeman as the principal executive office but says Snowflake has no corporate headquarters.
The FY2024 Form 10-K lists New York principal executive offices and identifies Atlas and Enterprise Advanced as offerings.

The FY2024 Form 10-K lists San Francisco principal executive offices and separately discusses a planned Sydney global headquarters. The Delaware parent succeeded the prior English and Welsh entity in 2022.
The company-issued 2021 Series D release calls Postman San Francisco headquartered and describes its API platform. Historical legal suffix remains unreviewed.
The FY2024 Form 10-K says GitLab is remote-only and has no headquarters. Delaware incorporation and a service-agent address do not establish a U.S. operating base.
The 2023 Form 10-K lists New York principal executive offices and also identifies New York as the company's headquarters.
The FY2024 Form 10-K lists Austin principal executive offices and describes the Falcon platform.
The company Series A announcement calls Vanta San Francisco headquartered and describes security monitoring and compliance automation. Historical legal suffix remains unreviewed.
The FY2024 Form 10-K lists New York principal executive offices and labels its New York office the global headquarters. The original business began in Bucharest.
The 2023 Form 10-K lists Denver principal executive offices and a Denver corporate headquarters; it describes Gotham, Foundry, Apollo and AIP.
ITOCHU's 2022 partnership announcement identifies DataRobot, Inc. as Boston headquartered and describes its machine learning platform.

claims.interpretation: Both companies' disclosures support a testable hypothesis that customer workload and technology-spending changes can affect operating performance: Datadog says customer usage expands with cloud workloads and warns that IT spending changes may affect its business; Snowflake reports consumption-based product revenue and says customers may optimize consumption in response to macroeconomic uncertainty. This establishes a common possible driver, not shared customers or observed co-movement.
